_comment: Derived-figure map (Red Team Fix 2, 2026-10-16). G maintains this file. Each figure is a total built from parts. publish_guard recomputes every total from its parts on publish and warns on a mismatch (warn only). When you edit a part anywhere on the site, edit it here too and re-check the totals it feeds.

_field_definitions.total: the number the site shows for the total (in `unit`)
_field_definitions.op: sum (default) | product | diff (parts[0] - rest) | ratio (parts[0] / parts[1])
_field_definitions.parts: list of {label, value} in the same unit; value may also be the id of another figure
_field_definitions.tolerance: absolute slack for rounding (default 0.5% of total)
_field_definitions.total_text: optional: exact text the site shows for the total (e.g. 'about 2.43B shares'); warns if it is no longer found on the site, so a stale copy elsewhere gets noticed
_field_definitions.where: optional: files/cards that show the total
